title: Content
subtitle: 「內容／材料／資訊／貼文」，先分清是整體素材、事實資訊、文字、文章、社交貼文，還是數碼媒體。
description: 「內容／材料／資訊／貼文」，先分清是整體素材、事實資訊、文字、文章、社交貼文，還是數碼媒體。

words.example: The course includes updated reading material.
words.exampleZh: 課程包括已更新的閱讀材料。

exercises.original: The course includes updated content for each module.
exercises.zh: 課程每個單元都包括更新材料。
exercises.upgrade: The course includes updated material for each module.

options.explanation: course/module 語境中，material 可自然涵蓋閱讀、練習和教學素材。
課程內容不只數據，可能還有文章、例子和活動。
格式只是呈現方式，不是教學內容本身。
設計影響版面與體驗，但不等於課程材料。
檔案只是載體，同一材料可存在多個檔案。
廣告只是特定類型內容，與一般課程材料不符。

exercises.original: The website contains educational content for teachers.
exercises.zh: 網站載有供教師使用的教育材料。
exercises.upgrade: The website contains educational material for teachers.

options.explanation: educational material 是網站教學內容的自然總稱。
網站可能有檔案，但內容不只檔案本身。
網站設計不是教育資訊。

exercises.original: The editor removed outdated content from the handbook.
exercises.zh: 編輯從手冊刪除過時材料。
exercises.upgrade: The editor removed outdated material from the handbook.

options.explanation: handbook 中的文字／資訊內容可自然稱 material。
這只指目錄頁，不等於所有過時內容。
刪除內容和更改格式不同。
handbook 可以是一個 file，但句子講其內部內容。

words.example: The page contains useful information about the application process.
words.exampleZh: 該頁載有關於申請程序的實用資訊。

exercises.original: The page contains useful content about the application process.
exercises.zh: 該頁載有關於申請程序的實用資訊。
exercises.upgrade: The page contains useful information about the application process.

options.explanation: application process 的 facts/details 最自然是 information。
頁面設計不會告訴你申請步驟。
可能承載資訊，但不是資訊本身。
資訊可能包含文字和其他形式，不能只限圖片。

exercises.original: Users need clear content about fees and deadlines.
exercises.zh: 使用者需要清楚的費用和截止日期資訊。
exercises.upgrade: Users need clear information about fees and deadlines.

options.explanation: fees and deadlines 是具體事實資料。
太強調媒介形式，沒有必要。
資訊可以出現在任何頁面，不限貼文。
費用與截止日期說明不是廣告的同義詞。

exercises.original: The guide provides content on where to get help.
exercises.zh: 指南提供如何取得協助的資訊。
exercises.upgrade: The guide provides information on where to get help.

options.explanation: where to get help 是實用說明資料。
廣告不是求助指南資訊。

words.example: The account publishes several educational posts each week.
words.exampleZh: 該帳戶每週發布數篇教育貼文。

exercises.original: The account publishes educational content every day.
exercises.zh: 該帳戶每天發布教育貼文。
exercises.upgrade: The account publishes educational posts every day.

options.explanation: account + publishes every day 是社交／平台貼文的典型語境。
發布的可以是檔案，但 account content 更自然是 posts。
格式不是發布內容單位。
在此數碼語境中通常不用 contents 指一篇篇貼文。

exercises.original: Users can comment on content published in the forum.
exercises.zh: 使用者可以評論論壇內發布的帖子。
exercises.upgrade: Users can comment on posts published in the forum.

options.explanation: forum 中可被逐篇評論的內容通常是 posts。
forum 文章可能附檔，但不是核心發布單位。

exercises.original: The platform removed several pieces of harmful content.
exercises.zh: 平台移除了數篇有害貼文。
exercises.upgrade: The platform removed several harmful posts.

options.explanation: several pieces + platform moderation 很適合具體 posts。
私訊／訊息只是平台內容的一類，過窄。

words.example: The documentary deals with difficult subject matter.
words.exampleZh: 這套紀錄片處理較艱深的題材。

exercises.original: The documentary deals with difficult content.
exercises.zh: 這套紀錄片處理較艱深的題材。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary deals with difficult subject matter.

options.explanation: documentary deals with... 是談作品主題／題材。
紀錄片形式不是它討論的議題。
可能出現數據，但不是整體題材。

exercises.original: Parents were warned that the film contains sensitive content.
exercises.zh: 家長獲提醒電影包含敏感題材。
exercises.upgrade: Parents were warned that the film contains sensitive subject matter.

options.explanation: sensitive subject matter 是電影分級／提示中的常見搭配。
電影格式不等於敏感題材。

exercises.original: The lecturer adjusted the content to suit younger students.
exercises.zh: 講師調整了主題內容，以適合較年幼學生。
exercises.upgrade: The lecturer adjusted the subject matter to suit younger students.

options.explanation: suit younger students 表示調整所教授的題材／議題。
可能也要調整形式，但原句重點是內容本身。

words.example: The lesson combines text with interactive media.
words.exampleZh: 課堂把文字與互動媒體內容結合。

exercises.original: The lesson combines written content with video and audio.
exercises.zh: 課堂把文字內容與影音媒體結合。
exercises.upgrade: The lesson combines text with video and audio media.

options.explanation: video and audio 都是 media 類型。
影音不只是可分析數據。
mp4/mp3 是檔案載體，但重點是媒體形式。
format 是編碼／呈現形式，不等同媒體內容。

exercises.original: The app allows users to upload visual content.
exercises.zh: 應用程式容許使用者上載視覺媒體內容。
exercises.upgrade: The app allows users to upload visual media.

options.explanation: visual media 可包括圖片、影片等。
JPEG/MP4 等是格式，不是內容本身。
視覺內容不只設計作品。

exercises.original: The campaign uses different types of content, including images and short videos.
exercises.zh: 宣傳活動使用不同媒體，包括圖片和短片。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign uses different media, including images and short videos.

options.explanation: images and videos 是不同媒體形式。
JPG/MP4 才是格式；images/videos 是媒體內容。
這些媒體未必以貼文形式發布。
campaign content 可包含很多非廣告素材。

words.example: The designer shortened the text on the landing page.
words.exampleZh: 設計師縮短了登陸頁面的文字內容。

exercises.original: The designer shortened the content on the landing page.
exercises.zh: 設計師縮短了登陸頁面的文字內容。
exercises.upgrade: The designer shortened the text on the landing page.

options.explanation: shortened 表示可編輯的書面文字，landing page 語境很自然。
不能『縮短格式』來保留原意。
可以簡化設計，但不是文字內容。
text 本身就是一種內容形式，這裡不需泛稱 media。

exercises.original: Please check the content for spelling errors.
exercises.zh: 請檢查文字內容有沒有串字錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: Please check the text for spelling errors.

options.explanation: spelling errors 只出現在文字，所以 text 最精準。
視覺設計不會有串字錯誤。
格式錯誤和 spelling 不同。
圖片本身不是主要拼字檢查對象。

exercises.original: The page has too much written content.
exercises.zh: 頁面的文字內容太多。
exercises.upgrade: The page has too much text.

options.explanation: written content 可直接自然改寫成 text。

words.meaning: 文案；宣傳文字；頁面文字
words.example: The marketing team rewrote the homepage copy.
words.exampleZh: 市場推廣團隊重寫了首頁文案。

exercises.original: The marketing team rewrote the website content.
exercises.zh: 市場推廣團隊重寫了網站文案。
exercises.upgrade: The marketing team rewrote the website copy.

options.explanation: marketing team + website wording 是 copy 的典型專業用法。
只說主題，不是實際商業文字。

exercises.original: The advertisement needs shorter content and a stronger headline.
exercises.zh: 廣告需要更短文案和更有力標題。
exercises.upgrade: The advertisement needs shorter copy and a stronger headline.

options.explanation: advertisement + headline 是 advertising copy 的直接語境。
廣告文案不只是事實資訊，還有說服語言。
headline 和 wording 屬文案，不是純設計。

exercises.original: She writes content for email campaigns and landing pages.
exercises.zh: 她為電郵宣傳和登陸頁撰寫文案。
exercises.upgrade: She writes copy for email campaigns and landing pages.

options.explanation: email campaigns / landing pages 的商業文字最常稱 copy。
她是寫文字，不是做視覺設計。

words.example: The site publishes articles on personal finance.
words.exampleZh: 該網站發布個人理財文章。

exercises.original: The site publishes long-form content on personal finance.
exercises.zh: 網站發布個人理財長篇文章。
exercises.upgrade: The site publishes long-form articles on personal finance.

options.explanation: long-form + topic publication 最自然是 articles。
post 可長可短，但 long-form editorial content 更精準叫 articles。

exercises.original: Readers can browse content written by the magazine's editors.
exercises.zh: 讀者可以瀏覽雜誌編輯撰寫的文章。
exercises.upgrade: Readers can browse articles written by the magazine's editors.

options.explanation: magazine editors written pieces 是 articles。

exercises.original: The knowledge base contains hundreds of help-content pieces.
exercises.zh: 知識庫包含數百篇協助文章。
exercises.upgrade: The knowledge base contains hundreds of help articles.

options.explanation: knowledge base 的完整 help pieces 常稱 help articles。
知識庫條目通常不是社交／論壇 posts。
文章可儲存在檔案，但不是檔案概念。

words.example: The company produces digital content for schools.
words.exampleZh: 公司為學校製作數碼內容。

exercises.original: The company produces content for websites, apps and social platforms.
exercises.zh: 公司為網站、應用程式和社交平台製作數碼內容。
exercises.upgrade: The company produces digital content for websites, apps and social platforms.

options.explanation: websites/apps/social platforms 都是數碼發布環境。
數碼內容可包含文字、影音等。

exercises.original: Schools increasingly use online content alongside textbooks.
exercises.zh: 學校愈來愈常把數碼內容和教科書一同使用。
exercises.upgrade: Schools increasingly use digital content alongside textbooks.

options.explanation: online content 與 textbooks 對比，digital 最直接。

exercises.original: The subscription gives access to exclusive content in the app.
exercises.zh: 訂閱可取用應用程式內的獨家數碼內容。
exercises.upgrade: The subscription gives access to exclusive digital content in the app.

options.explanation: in the app 明確是數碼內容。
內容可以串流或動態生成，不必是可見檔案。

words.example: The archive contains published material from the 1990s.
words.exampleZh: 檔案庫收錄了九十年代已發布的材料。

exercises.original: The archive contains content published by the organisation in the 1990s.
exercises.zh: 檔案庫收錄機構於九十年代已發布的材料。
exercises.upgrade: The archive contains published material from the organisation in the 1990s.

options.explanation: archive + published in the 1990s 強調已正式公開的資料。
draft 與 published 狀態相反。
檔案是載體，published material 才是內容。

exercises.original: Copyright rules apply to content already made public.
exercises.zh: 版權規則適用於已公開發布的材料。
exercises.upgrade: Copyright rules apply to published material.

options.explanation: already made public 是 published 的直接線索。
版權保護內容，不是單純格式。

exercises.original: The publisher may reuse content that appeared in earlier editions.
exercises.zh: 出版商可重用早期版本已發布的材料。
exercises.upgrade: The publisher may reuse published material from earlier editions.

options.explanation: appeared in earlier editions 表示已出版內容。
可能是內容一部分，但不是總稱。

words.example: Students can access extra learning resources online.
words.exampleZh: 學生可在網上取用額外學習資源。

exercises.original: Students can access extra content to help them revise.
exercises.zh: 學生可取用額外學習資源幫助溫習。
exercises.upgrade: Students can access extra learning resources to help them revise.

options.explanation: to help them revise 表示內容的學習支援用途。
學習資源可包括影片、工作紙、測驗等。

exercises.original: The help centre offers content for new users.
exercises.zh: 支援中心為新使用者提供參考資源。
exercises.upgrade: The help centre offers resources for new users.

options.explanation: help centre 的內容目的是支援使用者完成任務。
支援內容不限下載檔案。

exercises.original: Teachers can download classroom content from the portal.
exercises.zh: 教師可以從平台下載課堂教學資源。
exercises.upgrade: Teachers can download classroom resources from the portal.

options.explanation: classroom materials intended for teaching are naturally resources。
下載內容不一定是貼文。

words.example: The platform relies heavily on user-generated content.
words.exampleZh: 該平台高度依賴用戶生成內容。

exercises.original: The platform relies heavily on content created by its users.
exercises.zh: 平台高度依賴用戶自行製作的內容。
exercises.upgrade: The platform relies heavily on user-generated content.

options.explanation: created by its users 是 UGC 的直接定義。
由編輯／品牌撰寫，不是用戶產出。
來源是 staff，與 users 相反。
用戶內容可包含文字、圖片、影片、評論等。

exercises.original: Reviews and customer photos form much of the site's content.
exercises.zh: 評論和顧客照片構成網站大量用戶生成內容。
exercises.upgrade: Reviews and customer photos form much of the site's user-generated content.

options.explanation: reviews + customer photos 是典型 UGC。
是機構正式發布，不是用戶產出。

exercises.original: Moderators check content submitted by community members.
exercises.zh: 版主檢查社群成員提交的用戶生成內容。
exercises.upgrade: Moderators check user-generated content submitted by community members.

options.explanation: submitted by community members 明確是由用戶創作。
過窄且來源通常是品牌。

words.example: The presentation was attractive, but its substance was weak.
words.exampleZh: 簡報外觀吸引，但實質內容薄弱。

exercises.original: The presentation looked impressive, but its content was weak.
exercises.zh: 簡報外觀吸引，但實質內容薄弱。
exercises.upgrade: The presentation looked impressive, but its substance was weak.

options.explanation: 和 looked impressive 形成 form/style vs meaningful content 的對比。
格式可能漂亮，但 weak format 不是原句要批評的核心思想。
前半句已承認外觀吸引。
內容不足不一定是缺數據。

exercises.original: The argument has plenty of style but little content.
exercises.zh: 這個論點形式很多，但實質內容很少。
exercises.upgrade: The argument has plenty of style but little substance.

options.explanation: style vs substance 是固定而自然的對比。
style 已經涵蓋呈現方式。

exercises.original: The report needs more meaningful content, not just attractive graphics.
exercises.zh: 報告需要更多實質內容，而不只是吸引的圖像。
exercises.upgrade: The report needs more substance, not just attractive graphics.

options.explanation: not just attractive graphics 明確要求更有意義的核心內容。
graphics 已是 design 部分。
需要的是 ideas/information，不是增加更多媒體。

words.meaning: 網上發布的內容；網上材料
words.example: All material published online must follow the editorial policy.
words.exampleZh: 所有在網上發布的內容都必須遵守編輯政策。

exercises.original: All online content must follow the editorial policy.
exercises.zh: 所有網上發布的內容都必須遵守編輯政策。
exercises.upgrade: All material published online must follow the editorial policy.

options.explanation: 是 online content 的透明描述性改寫，且符合 editorial policy 語境。
政策通常規管實際內容，不只是格式。

exercises.original: The organisation reviews content before it appears on its website.
exercises.zh: 機構在內容於網站發布前進行審核。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation reviews material before it is published online.

options.explanation: appears on its website 對應 online publication。
網站內容不一定以可下載檔案呈現。

exercises.original: The rules apply to content placed on the public website.
exercises.zh: 規則適用於放在公開網站上的內容。
exercises.upgrade: The rules apply to material published online on the public website.

options.explanation: public website 明確是已發布的網上材料。
public website 與 internal 相反。
public website 與 private messages 不同。

falseSynonyms.zh: contents 不等於所有 content contents 常指容器內的東西，或書籍的目錄／內容物；數碼『內容』通常用不可數 content。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Content is often uncountable information or media; contents often means things inside something or a table of contents.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數據不等於 content data 是可分析的數據／資料；content 可以包含文章、圖片、影片、意見等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Data can be part of content, but content is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 檔案不等於 content file 是儲存內容的數碼單位；同一內容可存在不同 file formats。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A file is a container or digital object; content is what it contains.

falseSynonyms.zh: 格式不等於 content format 是呈現／檔案形式，例如 PDF、video、HTML；content 是實際資訊或素材。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Format describes how something is presented, not what it says or contains.

falseSynonyms.zh: 設計不等於 content design 關乎版面、視覺、結構和體驗；content 關乎文字、資訊、影音等材料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Design shapes presentation; content supplies the material or message.

falseSynonyms.zh: 廣告不等於所有 content 廣告是一種特定目的的內容；content 可以教育、娛樂、說明或記錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An advertisement is one type of content, not a general synonym.

falseSynonyms.zh: 訊息不等於所有 content message 是要傳達的核心意思；content 還包括細節、圖片、例子和形式素材。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A message is the main meaning; content can contain far more than the message.

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意同形異義詞 形容詞 content /kənˈtent/ 表示『滿足的』，和名詞 content /ˈkɒntent/『內容』不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The adjective content means satisfied; the noun content means material or information.
